proposal.quote: There is no intention here of declaring war on Russia and Lord Halifax said he knew that was the view of the French Government also
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The report treats Britain and France as already belligerents weighing whether to extend the war to Russia, which shows a British and French war with Germany in force.

proposal.quote: There is no intention here of declaring war on Russia
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The charge in London reports that Britain, already a belligerent, will not add a declaration of war against Russia, which shows Britain at war.

proposal.quote: than simply to hold it in reserve in France where no battles are now taking place
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: France is described as a front where no battles are currently taking place, indicating that France is at war with Germany rather than at peace.

proposal.quote: A blue book is to be published next week of the Anglo-French-Russian negotiations at Moscow giving the full story of the breakdown.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The document reports the breakdown of the Anglo-French-Russian negotiations, so no alliance was concluded.

proposal.quote: Deliveries of the oil and fodder previously agreed upon are under way.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that oil previously agreed between Germany and the Soviet Union is being delivered, showing an overland supply arrangement outside the blockade and meeting the secured threshold.

proposal.quote: Japan has for some time been desirous of transferring the troops along the Siberian border for use in China
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Japanese troops being held for use in China, reported as an ongoing state of affairs, meets the threshold of Japan's army engaged in a general war in China.

proposal.quote: the belligerent powers including Germany
